name: Property-Based Testing Golden Dataset
description: Evaluates the agent's ability to generate and reason about property-based tests (RFC-test-automation.md).

test_cases.prompt: Write a complete Go program (package main) that defines a function Add(a, b int) int and a main function that verifies the property Add(a,b) == Add(b,a) for many pseudo-random integer pairs. Output the code in a fenced Go code block.
test_cases.description: Generates a valid Go program that demonstrates a property check.

test_cases.prompt: Explain how you would use sin_property to test the property that reversing a string twice returns the original string. Mention the tool name and the property.
test_cases.description: Verifies the agent knows when to use the property tool.
